mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers earnings revisions downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 normalization phase, CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeding 2.0% signals Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 2.0% during post-2008 normalization.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic momentum that depresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market slack (UNRATE > 7.0%), non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) declining below 100,000 monthly additions signals deteriorating employment trends that reduce consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 100000 and UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1% and CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeding 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.0%.
